Five-Bean Chilli for a Flat of 6
Serves 6 | Prep 15 min | Cook 40 min
2 tbsp olive oil
2 onions, chopped
3 garlic cloves
2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin
2 x 400g tins mixed beans, drained
1 x 400g tin chopped tomatoes
250ml veg stock
Fry onion 8 min, add garlic and spices for 1 min, then everything else. Simmer 30 min. Approx. £1.10 per portion.

Mug Brownie (microwave)
4 tbsp self-raising flour
4 tbsp sugar
2 tbsp cocoa powder
3 tbsp milk
2 tbsp vegetable oil
Pinch of salt
Mix in a large mug until smooth. Microwave on high (800W) for 1 min 30 sec. Leave 2 minutes before eating: it's very hot!

Dorm Microwave Mac & Cheese (1 serving)
1/2 cup elbow macaroni
1/2 cup water
1/4 cup milk
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
Pinch of salt and black pepper
Microwave the pasta and water in a large mug for 2 min, stir, then 2 min more (repeat until tender, about 6 min total). Stir in the milk and cheese; heat 30 sec. Approx. 410 calories.

Overnight Oats, 1 jar
50g rolled oats
120ml milk (any kind)
2 tbsp Greek yoghurt
1 tsp honey
Handful of berries
Stir, put the lid on and leave in the fridge overnight. Keeps 2 days. 380 kcal per jar, approx. 75p.

Shakshuka, serves 2
1 tbsp oil, 1 onion, 1 red pepper
2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes
400g tin chopped tomatoes
4 eggs
Feta & coriander to finish
Soften onion and pepper 10 min. Add garlic, spices and tomatoes; simmer 10 min. Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover for 6 to 8 min.

Abuela Nuñez's Tortilla
Serves 4, 45 minutes
600 g waxy potatoes, thinly sliced
1 onion, sliced
6 large eggs
200 ml olive oil
1 tsp salt
Cook the potatoes and onion gently in the oil for 20 min; drain. Beat the eggs with the salt, add the potatoes, rest 10 min. Cook in a 24 cm pan, 5 min per side.

Halls Kitchen Soda Bread
500 g plain flour
1 tsp bicarbonate of soda
1 tsp salt
400 ml buttermilk
Oven 200 °C / 180 °C fan / gas 6

A Short History of Brackenhurst College
The College was founded in 1868 by the cotton merchant Josiah Brackenhurst, who left £40,000 for "the education of young men of modest means". The first 26 students arrived in October 1871, when the Old Quad was still half built.
Women were admitted in 1974, and by 1980 they made up 41% of the student body. Today the College has some 520 undergraduates and 310 postgraduates from more than 60 countries.

Experiment 5: Determining g with a Simple Pendulum
Aim: to measure the acceleration due to gravity to within 2%.
Set the string length L to 0.500 m, measured from the pivot to the centre of the bob. Displace the bob by no more than 10° and time 20 complete oscillations; repeat three times.
The period is T = t/20, and g = 4π²L/T². With L = 0.500 m you should find T ≈ 1.42 s.

2.3 The Mean and the Median
Suppose the weekly rents paid by five students are £120, £135, £135, £150 and £410. The mean is £950 ÷ 5 = £190, but four of the five students pay less than that.
The median, the middle value when the data are in order, is £135. When a data set contains an extreme value such as £410, the median is often the better summary of a typical value.

Fire Safety in Halls
Last year, 212 fire alarms in our residences were false alarms, and 140 of those were caused by cooking. Every false alarm means up to 600 students standing outside, often at night.
Never leave cooking unattended, keep kitchen doors shut and do not cover smoke detectors. Candles, incense and fairy lights that plug into the mains are not allowed.
Tampering with fire equipment carries a fine of £150 and may lead to disciplinary action.

The Clock Tower
Standing 46 metres high, the Clock Tower has been the symbol of the university since it was completed in 1904. Its four faces are each 3.2 m across, and the hour bell, known to students as "Big Agnes", weighs 2.4 tonnes.
